items.title: Safari introduces Adaptive Dark Mode in 27.3
items.blurb: We’re excited to announce Adaptive Dark Mode in Safari 27.3 beta.

items.title: Vitest 5: Prioritises Performance with a Shared Vite Server, Trace View, and Stricter Test Defaults
items.blurb: Vitest 5.0 focuses on speed, with reported gains of 8 to 25 percent in most setups and up to 53 percent in VM pools. It adds a vitest doctor command, Browser Mode Trace View, and vi.when.

items.title: LLVM Vulkan 1.1: Drop-in compiler passes (GVN, CSE, CFG, DCE) on Vulkan compute with benchmarks & Clang integration
items.blurb: Hey r/programming and r/Compilers , I've just released LLVM Vulkan 1.1 , an open-source project that moves beyond an experimental prototype into a drop-in pass plugin that accelerates LLVM middle-end passes using portable Vulkan compute…
